item.title: BALLONDOR ACADEMY
item.description: BallonDor Academy is a SaaS platform built for sports academies — the kind of software that handles enrollment, schedules, fees, and everything else a coaching academy needs to actually run as a business.

item.title: GOLDEN SEAT
item.description: Golden Seat is a platform for events and experiences — ticket sales, bookings, the whole flow from “I want to go to this thing” to “I have a confirmation in my inbox.

item.title: LASIKAR
item.description: Lasikar is a suite of business tools — Lasikar OS (a SaaS app businesses run their day-to-day on), Lasikar AI, and Lasikar Cloud. We’ve worked with the team across all three.

item.title: MDG ACADEMY
item.description: MdG Academy is the education arm of the MdG family. We built the website with a focus on speed and reliability — students and parents don’t want to wait around for pages to load, especially on phones.

item.title: MDG COLD
item.description: MdG Cold needed a website that worked — properly. We built it from scratch, then locked it down with proper security, and tuned it so pages load fast on slow connections too.

item.title: MDG OMNIA
item.description: MdG Omnia is the third site in the MdG family we’ve worked on. Same playbook, tuned for what Omnia specifically needed — a clean website, fast loads, and a proper security setup so the team doesn’t have to think about it.
